question: Who among the following Indian Musicians and tabla players was the very first to be invited in 2016 by the then American President Barack Obama to attend the All-Star Global Concert held in the White House?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zakir Hussain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Zakir Hussain**

 
 
• **Zakir Hussain **is an Indian actor, percussionist, composer, **tabla player and well-known music producer**.
 
• He is the **oldest child **of tabla player **Alla Rakha**.
 
• He received the** Padma Shri honour in 1988 **and the **Padma Bhushan honour in 2002**.
 
• He was also **honoured with the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1990**.
 
• Zakir Hussain was the** very first Indian Musician and tabla player to be invited in 2016 by the then American President Barack Obama to attend the All-Star Global Concert held in the White House**.
 
• The **Humanities Council at Princeton University** designated him an **Old Dominion Fellow**. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alla Rakha**

 
 
• He was a** tabla player from India who excelled in Hindustani classical music**.
 
• He was born in J**ammu's Ghagwal Village, in Jammu and Kashmir**.
 
• In **1977, he received a Padma Shri**, and in 1**982, he was awarded Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**.
 
 
 
• **Swapan Chaudhari**
 
 
• A **tabla player from India** is named **Swapan Chaudhuri**.
 
• He was **nominated for the Percussive Arts Society Hall of Fame** and **awarded the American Academy of Artists Award**.
 
• The greatest honour for classical music in India, **the Sangeet Natak Academy Award**, was given to Swapan Chaudhuri by the **President of India in 1996**.
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Shri in 2019**, which is one of** India's highest honours, by the Indian government**.
 
 
 
• **Anindo Chatterjee**
 
 
• He is a** tabla player from India**.
 
• When **US President Barack Obama visited India in November 2010**, he gave a performance at **Rashtrapati Bhavan**.
 
• In **2002**, the** Sangeet Natak Academy Award **was given to him.
